user.title: SolarSplit
user.description: Choose the grid sensors and the global settings of the surplus control loop.

data_description.export_sensor: Power exported to the grid, in W. Main signal of the loop.
data_description.import_sensor: Power imported from the grid, in W. Used to detect a deficit.
data_description.pv_sensor: PV production, in W. Needed for zero-injection mode.
data_description.zero_injection_entity: When this entity is on, the inverter limits export and the loop probes loads instead.
data_description.global_condition: When this entity is off, the loop switches off the loads it switched on that respect it, and leaves the rest as they are.
data_description.cycle_interval: How often the control loop runs.
data_description.safety_margin: Power never handed out to loads.
data_description.smoothing_window: Moving average applied to the readings to filter clouds and spikes.
data_description.settle_time: Wait after a change before the next one.
data_description.on_margin: Extra power a load needs, above its own, to be switched on.
data_description.import_tolerance: Grid import tolerated before a load is switched off.
data_description.shadow_mode: Decide and publish decisions without switching any load. Turn off only when the decisions look right.

data_description.name: Shown on the load's device.
data_description.entity_id: Switch, input boolean or climate entity that turns the load on and off.
data_description.nominal_power: Power the load draws when on.
data_description.power_sensor: Measured power of the load. When set, it is used instead of the nominal power.
data_description.no_skip: Only switch on when every eligible load before it is on.
data_description.on_delay: The surplus must cover the load for this long before it is switched on.
data_description.off_delay: The deficit must last this long before the load is switched off.
data_description.min_on: Never switch off sooner after switching on. Protects compressors and pumps.
data_description.min_off: Never switch on sooner after switching off.
data_description.respect_global_condition: When the global condition is off, switch this load off if SolarSplit switched it on; otherwise leave it as it is. Untick for loads that must keep running, such as a pool pump.
data_description.condition_entity: The load is only used while this entity has the state below.
data_description.condition_state: State the usage condition entity must have, for example on.
data_description.respect_manual: If someone else switches the load, stop controlling it until it returns to the state SolarSplit set.
data_description.variable_entity: While this entity is on (for example FreeDS master), the load is regulated elsewhere: SolarSplit never switches it, but its power counts.
